relations.rationale: The workshop opening early has no bearing on who took photographs.
Opening time of the workshop is unrelated to study group membership.
The workshop's opening time doesn't affect whether Ben stayed up late.
Tables of gears has no bearing on what Sami carried.
The presence of gear tables is consistent with and generally supports an active robotics event including testing, but doesn't directly imply it.
Tables of gears in the hall have no connection to who sat with whom at lunch.
The setup of tables has no bearing on who is lead volunteer.
The physical setup of tables doesn't relate to Vik's enjoyment of competition.
Isla being lead volunteer has no bearing on her height relative to Ben.
Isla's role as lead volunteer doesn't relate to height comparisons among Kai, Isla, and Ben.
Isla being lead volunteer has no connection to Sami laughing at a wheel axle popping off.
If Isla is the lead volunteer, then the claim that she is not the lead volunteer is directly false.
Isla's role as lead volunteer has no bearing on people's agreement about a difference being small.
Ben arriving after Sami doesn't determine what Ben was carrying.
Ben's arrival time relative to Sami doesn't determine what Sami carried.
Ben's late arrival relative to Sami doesn't relate to Vik having already claimed a seat.
Ben's arrival time has no bearing on study group membership with Vik.
Ben's arrival time doesn't directly relate to whether his diagram impressed others.
Ben's arrival timing relative to Sami has no bearing on Vik's reactions during robot competition.
If Ben was carrying the folder of diagrams, it's less likely (though not impossible) that Sami was also carrying the same type of folder, especially if only one such folder existed.
